_comment: Spec-derived expectations for page-ops.svg (03-01 task 2). Positions are 1-based. Sizes are user units (1 user unit = 1 mm in this fixture); PDF MediaBox values are pt (+-0.5). 'label' is the effective label (explicit inkscape:label, else the positional default "Page N" under LC_ALL=C). 'preset' mirrors inkscape:page-size (null = attribute must be absent). Expectations are derived from the plan and the upstream page model, NOT from observed output; contradictions are recorded in /tmp/glm-0301-task2-findings.md and only then encoded here with a _note.

insert-before._note: Spec values hold for positions, sizes and item placement. Back keeps its A5 preset: the bubble move swaps rects through SPPage::setRect, which clears _size_label (sp-page.cpp:208-217). Review gate (03-01): PageOps now restores size labels after reorder/delete on every surviving page whose size is unchanged (SizeLabelKeeper, actions-page-manager.cpp), honouring setRect's 'caller puts it back' contract without touching upstream; the earlier observed null preset was that defect.

duplicate-after._note: Spec values hold for positions, sizes and item placement. Back keeps its A5 preset: the bubble move swaps rects through SPPage::setRect, which clears _size_label (sp-page.cpp:208-217). Review gate (03-01): PageOps now restores size labels after reorder/delete on every surviving page whose size is unchanged (SizeLabelKeeper, actions-page-manager.cpp), honouring setRect's 'caller puts it back' contract without touching upstream; the earlier observed null preset was that defect.

move-to._note: Spec values hold for positions, sizes and item placement. Back keeps its A5 preset: the bubble move swaps rects through SPPage::setRect, which clears _size_label (sp-page.cpp:208-217). Review gate (03-01): PageOps now restores size labels after reorder/delete on every surviving page whose size is unchanged (SizeLabelKeeper, actions-page-manager.cpp), honouring setRect's 'caller puts it back' contract without touching upstream; the earlier observed null preset was that defect. Back is the viewport page afterwards, so its exported label also relies on the SPNamedView::updateViewPort guard.

remove-contents._note: Back DOES stay an explicit view (answering the plan's question for page-manager.cpp:283-298): isBarePage() (sp-page.cpp:112-118) only checks margin/bleed, and those are engaged with default 0 for this page, so the last remaining page is not auto-removed. deletePage deletes only Front with its contents, then fits the document to Back's rect (root 210x148); fitToRect's movePages moves Back onto the origin (rect2 to 20,20) through SPPage::setRect, which clears its A5 label. Review gate (03-01): PageOps now restores size labels after reorder/delete on every surviving page whose size is unchanged (SizeLabelKeeper, actions-page-manager.cpp), honouring setRect's 'caller puts it back' contract without touching upstream; the earlier observed null preset was that defect. Back is the viewport page afterwards, so its exported label also relies on the SPNamedView::updateViewPort guard.

remove-last-refused._note: Same end state as remove-contents. The second remove hits the getPageCount() <= 1 guard in PageOps::remove_page and must be a logged no-op (g_warning, printed as WARNING on stderr, hence the allow-list entry). Back is the viewport page afterwards, so its exported label also relies on the SPNamedView::updateViewPort guard.
allow_warnings: page-remove: refusing to remove the last page

resize-all._note: Sizes: Letter landscape = 11x8.5 in = 279.4x215.9 mm on both pages, both labelled with the canonical preset name 'US Letter' (find_preset maps 'Letter' onto 'US Letter'). Front is the viewport page: resizing it goes through fitToRect and the deferred root->page sync (SPPage::setRect) used to wipe the label set by the action; resize_page now flushes that update (ensureUpToDate) before setSizeLabel (review gate 03-01). The exported SVG is a reloaded copy: loading re-synced the viewport page through setRect and dropped its page-size too; fixed by the minimal upstream guard in SPNamedView::updateViewPort (skip an unchanged rect; deviation, locked by test_page-manager-ops viewportPresetSurvivesReload).

page-nav._note: PgUp/PgDn page navigation (04-04 task 1). The document loads with its last page selected, so page-goto:1 selects Front; page-next then selects Back and prints 'page-next: selected page 2'. The second page-next is refused at the last page (no wrap) and prints nothing. page-previous returns to Front ('page-previous: selected page 1') and the second page-previous is refused at the first page. Stepping only selects a page and the selection is not exported, so the SVG is unchanged: both pages keep their geometry, label and preset. The selection is asserted through the g_message lines (the stderr_contains key), because page-list does not mark the selected page.
